integrity_summary_by_reference.source: Stage 3.0 Artifact Audit (not recomputed in this stage)
integrity_summary_by_reference.known_issues_note: 17 groups of pixel-identical images (34 rows) found in the preregistered ISIC 2019 / PAD-UFES-20 datasets, detected via bitwise-identical embedding vectors and independently confirmed via pixel-array comparison. 13/17 of these groups carry conflicting diagnostic labels for the same pixel-identical image. (Issue #1, logged, no action taken). 34/7365 rows (~0.46%) are pixel-identical duplicate pairs, included as-is per Stage 3.0's 'no action taken' decision. Their contribution to the descriptive statistics below is a small, symmetric double-count (each pair counted twice), not expected to shift any pooled statistic meaningfully at this sample size -- noted for completeness, not asserted as negligible without this note.

not_computed_here: No Mahalanobis, no probe accuracy, no LID, no spectral-decay slope, no Energy, no ViM, no KDE, no AUROC, no hypothesis-testing statistic of any kind. Per-domain breakdowns above are descriptive counts/means/percentiles only -- not a separability, distance, or significance claim; no comparison test was run.
